scope: Independent acceptance of frozen V3 request-kind extraction, action applicability and clarification dependencies, source-authority introspection, and exact-policy response-audit integration.

previous_acceptance.relationship: Earlier-version acceptance remains preserved; this record covers the specified V3 follow-up changes.

reviewed_changes: Typed request_kind plus quoted observable_symptom and requested_change facts; extraction instructions distinguish technical failures, feature changes, content requests and public how-to.
Concrete nonplayback app diagnostics without invented playback wording; grounded feature-request eligibility; catalog clarification that preserves known entities.
Clarification dependencies use current official evidence, describe missing facts and a potential downstream action, and withhold the actual procedure until its full prerequisites are met.
Known conflicting device/plan/region or operation conditions and expired authority block scope-dependent questions; genuine diagnostic questions remain source-independent.
Spotify Connect uses its existing current claim, preserves mandatory security handling and excludes an explicitly completed selector step.
Social closure may use an empty issue list only when typed request/fact evidence contains no open need.
KnowledgeStore.get_current checks current official authority, freshness and integrity without treating missing applicability facts as known.
Response-audit payload includes the exact frozen policy boundaries, mandatory-risk rules, version and hash; valid audit risk rationale is recorded without weakening the risk veto.

findings_resolved.finding: A typed playlist-search failure with a quoted freezing symptom lost device diagnosis because the downstream public-how-to procedure could not apply.
findings_resolved.resolution: Separate diagnostic context from procedure eligibility; a grounded named-function failure permits missing-device/version diagnosis without a redundant app_problem issue or current procedure authority.

findings_resolved.finding: Empty/social-only issues with social_closure=true could permit an acknowledgment despite a typed open request or quoted unresolved symptom/change.
findings_resolved.resolution: Social eligibility rejects typed open needs and observable_symptom/requested_change facts, including contradictory closure flags.

findings_resolved.finding: The new Connect card could repeat an explicitly completed device-selector step.
findings_resolved.resolution: Add an already-tried selector/picker exclusion and a quoted attempted-step regression.

findings_resolved.reported_by: action implementation owner during acceptance follow-up; independently verified
findings_resolved.finding: Question-shaped technical failures could be reinterpreted as public how-to by the legacy lexical fallback.
findings_resolved.resolution: Typed technical_failure now vetoes that fallback; the final contrast preserves version-only diagnosis for a freezing playlist search and verified instructions for a genuine public how-to.

validation.stage: V3 after initial review fixes, before the final narrow typed-howto veto
validation.command: python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_verified_agent.py tests/test_verified_actions.py tests/test_request_policy.py tests/test_knowledge.py

validation.stage: Final frozen actions revision, including the typed-howto veto
Independent focused integration and counterexample checks
checks: Audit payload boundaries and mandatory risk rules equal the frozen POLICY values and bind the exact version/SHA.
An audit that reports a new risk escalates even when it approves every exact alternative; its risk_reason is retained in the trace.
A quoted playlist-search failure receives local-policy-backed device diagnosis with fresh and expired procedure sources; its usage procedure stays withheld.
An unknown Connect device triggers the deterministic account-security route before response selection despite all-clear extracted risk flags.
At the final hashes, question-shaped playlist-search failure on a known iPhone receives missing-version diagnosis, while genuine public how-to retains verified search instructions.

review_constraints.test_inputs: Synthetic unit-test cases and independently constructed local counterexamples only.

limitations: This accepts the stated V3 code/contracts at the recorded hashes; it is not a release or deployment approval.
Live reply quality, calibration outcomes, held-out evaluation, human annotation and promotion are outside this review.
Quote validation establishes span provenance, not semantic truth; extraction and exact-response review still require independent quality evaluation.
The 265-test run preceded the final narrow action change. That final change received the recorded 133-test affected-suite run and an actual-registry contrast check.
Separate wire-schema/provider changes and comprehensive experiment-runner acceptance are outside this V3 review scope.
Current official claim factual review is recorded separately; this review checks authority and applicability contracts.
